episodes.content: Introduced herself: Nunzia Caruso, 57, pharmacist at Farmacia Talete (Siracusa, viale Teocrito) for 22 years, owner dott. Corrado Inguaggiato; rented flat in via della Giudecca, Ortigia; divorced; children Marta (28, Catania, married to Davide, expecting a girl end of April) and Salvo (31, software engineer in Dublin, girlfriend Aoife); mother Concetta (84) alone in Noto; cat Pirandello; grey 2011 Lancia Ypsilon; alto in Coro polifonico Santa Lucia (Thursday 21:00); book club «Le Lettrici di Ortigia» first Tuesday of the month at Lina's
February book club meeting cancelled (Lina had the flu)
Trip to Dublin to visit Salvo: planned 7–14 June, moved on 16 May to 28 June–5 July (Salvo's work trip to Berlin; flight change €90); took place 28 June–5 July
Asked the assistant for an Excel formula for days to expiry of drugs (help request)
GP dott.ssa Amato measured blood pressure 150/95; booked cardiology visit with dott. Bellomo for Tue 6 March 10:30; worried (father had a heart attack at 70)
Cardiology visit with dott. Bellomo: 6 March 10:30 → moved (conference in Rome) to 20 March 11:00 → moved (Bellomo's flu) to 3 April 9:00; took place 3 April
Choir rehearsal; preparing Pergolesi's Stabat Mater for the 24 March concert; got a solo part in «Quis est homo» from maestro Gino Pappalardo
Lunch at her mother's in Noto (pasta con le sarde); mother struggles with the stairs and refuses a carer; idea of a handrail
Met Enzo Gulino (61, widower, retired sailing instructor of the Lega Navale, boat «Ninfa») at a dinner at Lina's
Coffee with Enzo at Caffè del Porto (two hours) and walk on lungomare Alfeo; felt happy and nervous
Asked the assistant to write an English thank-you email to Brendan and Maeve Kelly (Aoife's parents) for a book about Irish gardens (help request)
Visited her mother in Noto; the handrail was installed; told her about Enzo; lunch pasta alla Norma
Book club at Lina's on «Lessico famigliare» (Ginzburg): Nunzia loved it, Lina found it boring; next book «Il Gattopardo»
Dinner with Enzo at Trattoria Don Saro (Ortigia) on Women's Day, mimosa; skipped choir rehearsal; first kiss, now a couple
Family group chat: Marta at 33 weeks, due date 28 April; Salvo becomes team lead from April (six people)
Sunset walk at the Plemmirio with Enzo
Colleague Francesco «Ciccio» Lombardo resigned from Farmacia Talete; from April works at a pharmacy in Sliema, Malta
Marta's baby shower at her home in Catania (first said Sunday 18, corrected to Saturday 17); ~20 people; Nunzia gave a yellow crocheted blanket
Choir dress rehearsal at Santa Lucia al Sepolcro; voice trembling
Stabat Mater concert at the basilica of Santa Lucia al Sepolcro: solo in «Quis est homo» went well, ~200 people, Enzo in the second row with red roses, maestro said «brava»
Called for an interview for director of the Farmacia Comunale di Noto (applied in February); asked the assistant to simulate the interview (help request)
Easter lunch at her mother's in Noto with Enzo (first meeting; mother approves)
Salvo's Easter visit cancelled: flight cancelled by an air-traffic-control strike
Cardiology visit: ECG and echo normal, grade-1 hypertension, ramipril 5 mg every morning from 4 April
Book club on «Il Gattopardo»: Nunzia found it beautiful but slow; next meeting moved from 1 May to 8 May («La Storia»)
Job interview at Palazzo Ducezio, Noto (committee incl. the pharmacist who will be her deputy, Paola — surname later corrected to Ferrante)
Weekend in Palermo with Lina (La traviata at Teatro Massimo, 14–15 April) cancelled because of her mother's fall; Lina went with her sister Pina
Mother fell in the bathroom around 23:00, femoral neck fracture, Avola hospital; Nunzia felt guilty
Mother's hip surgery (prosthesis), went well
Got the job of director of the Farmacia Comunale di Noto, starting 2 May; resigned from Talete (last day 30 April)
Last choir rehearsal she mentioned (distracted); plan to look at used cars at Autosud
Chose a white 2023 Peugeot 208 1.2 petrol at Autosud, Ypsilon traded in; price corrected from €13,500 to €12,800

Choir group chat: rehearsal of 26 April suspended (next 3 May); Rita marries Alfio on Saturday 15 September; Rita's unconfirmed claim that Nunzia moves to Malta; Tano's joke claims (owes him €50, allergic to shellfish)
Collected the white Peugeot 208; Ypsilon left at the dealer
Granddaughter Giulia born to Marta and Davide at 23:40 (3.2 kg, 50 cm), Catania
Held Giulia at the hospital in Catania; cried with emotion
Last day at Farmacia Talete; surprise farewell aperitivo, gift: fountain pen engraved N.C.; cried
First day as director of the Farmacia Comunale di Noto (staff: Paola, Salvatore, Giusi); mother moved to rehab at Villa Mimosa (Noto) from 30 April
Visit with Enzo to the Zampa Libera shelter; chose a black-and-tan mixed-breed female
Book club on «La Storia» (Morante), at page 300
Federfarma conference in Catania proposed by Paola for Saturday 26 May («maybe»)
58th birthday: dinner at Don Saro with Enzo; gift: sailing course at the Lega Navale (8 Sunday lessons from 20 May)
Adopted the dog Ciuri (female, ~2 years, black and tan, 14 kg) from Zampa Libera; Pirandello hissed
Helped an elderly customer with a weekly pill organiser together with Paola Ferrante
Sailing lesson 1 (instructor Marco, dinghy, fell in the water)
Asked the assistant to write a two-minute speech for Lina's retirement party (help request)
Medea at the Greek Theatre with Lina
Sailing lesson 2 (points of sail)
Decided to move to Noto: rented house via Rocco Pirri 12 (two bedrooms, courtyard, €550/month); lease to sign 19 June, move 23 June; plan to paint the kitchen sage green
Lina's retirement party (38 years teaching Latin at liceo Gargallo): read the speech, gift an e-bike, Enzo played guitar
Sailing lesson 3: first solo tack
Skipped the June book club meeting (tired, boxes)
Carmen Consoli concert at the Teatro Antico, Taormina, Friday 22 June (Enzo wants to go, «maybe»)
Edipo re at the Greek Theatre with Enzo (hot; Enzo fell asleep); preferred Medea
Sailing lesson 4: 12 knots, at the helm
Fish dinner at Marzamemi proposed by Enzo for Saturday 16 June («we'll see»)
Health authority inspection at the Noto pharmacy: perfect
Sailing lesson of 17 June cancelled (mistral 25 knots)
Mother back home from rehab with a walker
Live-in carer Irina (Moldovan) started at her mother's
Signed the lease of via Rocco Pirri 12 at the agency, got the keys
Painted the kitchen sage green with Enzo
Thursday dinner at her mother's (now a fixed weekly appointment)
Moved to Noto (via Rocco Pirri 12) with Enzo and Davide; sailing lesson of 24 June skipped
Returned the keys of the Ortigia flat; asked the assistant what to pack and see in Dublin (help request)
Dinner with Brendan and Maeve Kelly in Howth; Salvo and Aoife announced their engagement (wedding next year in Ireland)
Trinity College and the Book of Kells in the rain; pub with Salvo, disliked Guinness
Flew back to Catania (landed 21:10), Enzo picked her up; photo of Pirandello and Ciuri sleeping together
Marta, Davide and Giulia visited the new house; Giulia met her great-grandmother; photo of four generations
Sailing lesson 5 (three left, to be recovered in September)

Enzo has brought his things to via Rocco Pirri and his name is on the intercom (de facto cohabitation, never announced); mother now walks with a cane; home delivery for the elderly to start in September

notes.content: Nunzia Caruso, born 9 May 1971 (58 since 9 May 2029); from Siracusa (Ortigia), moved to Noto on 23 June 2029
Pharmacist; director of the Noto municipal pharmacy since 2 May 2029
Divorced; daughter Marta (Catania, husband Davide, daughter Giulia born 27 April 2029); son Salvo (Dublin, engaged to Aoife Kelly); mother Concetta (84, Noto)
Partner Enzo Gulino (61, retired sailing instructor, widower, boat «Ninfa») since March 2029; best friend Lina (retired Latin teacher)
Loved «Lessico famigliare»; found «Il Gattopardo» slow; preferred Medea to Edipo re; dislikes Guinness; loves Dublin but not its weather; prefers light-coloured cars
Grade-1 hypertension, ramipril 5 mg in the morning since 4 April 2029; healthy heart
Practises English with the assistant (son in Dublin)
